title: Tetra Halberds
description: A Halberd addon for the Tetra mod.
body:
This is a standalone addon to the [Tetra](https://modrinth.com/mod/tetra) mod, adding a new module for single headed polearms called the Halberd head.

Halberd modules by default give the weapon +0.5 reach aswell as the _puncture_ effect.
Hold right-click to charge an ability that applies a armor reduction debuff if the targets armor is above 5 or is not affected by the puncture effect already, otherwise inflict a 6 second long bleed.
